strengths: Minimal, surgical implementation: two one-line attribute additions with no props added and no logic changed.
TDD discipline followed correctly: tests committed in a RED commit before the GREEN implementation commit.
Tests use getByRole queries (not data-testid), validating real ARIA semantics.
Both static controlled rendering and dynamic uncontrolled state change are covered in the test suite.
aria-selected={isActive} correctly serializes boolean to 'true'/'false' string in the DOM as WAI-ARIA requires.
Copyright headers included in the new test file, consistent with project conventions.
All four planned tests are present and match the plan spec exactly.

critical.what: The entire 2.41.0 release entry (32 issues, 204 lines) was deleted. The file now starts at version 2.40.0.
critical.why: The release notes page will omit 32 shipped issues in production. This is real user-visible data loss caused by a bad merge conflict resolution during one of the three repeated merge-from-remote commits on this branch.
critical.fix: Restore the 2.41.0 block from git show b9eb50a664773f24b94988fd18bbf6b9dd3d2d98:src/configs/releaseNotes.json as the first entry in the file before merging.

important.what: The same three commits (Add failing ARIA tests, Fix ARIA roles, Add planning artifacts) appear three times each in the branch, interspersed with three merge-from-remote operations. The branch has 15 commits for 3 units of meaningful work.
important.why: The branch history is unreadable and will pollute the main branch log. It makes bisecting and future archaeology much harder.
important.fix: Rebase the branch interactively against main to collapse to 3 clean commits before merging.

minor.what: Test fixture tabs array is defined at module scope rather than inside beforeEach.
minor.why: No functional issue since the array is never mutated, but inconsistent with the pattern used in neighboring test files. If a future test mutates the array the shared reference will cause test pollution.
minor.fix: Either move the constant inside a beforeEach or add a comment noting the array is intentionally immutable and shared.

minor.what: No test covers the case where showTabs is false (single tab, alwaysShowTabs=false), which renders a tabpanel with no tablist.
minor.why: A lone tabpanel without a tablist is invalid WAI-ARIA structure. Documenting this edge case in a test would make the intentional behavior explicit.
minor.fix: Add an it('does not render tablist for a single tab by default') test asserting queryByRole('tablist') returns null.

minor.what: aria-controls, aria-labelledby, and Arrow-key keyboard navigation are missing for full WAI-ARIA APG tabs compliance.
minor.why: These were explicitly out of scope for this ticket but are required for a fully accessible tabs widget per the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide.
minor.fix: Open a follow-up ticket to add aria-controls on each tab pointing to its panel id, aria-labelledby on the tabpanel, and keyboard navigation.

recommendations: Restore the deleted 2.41.0 block in releaseNotes.json before merging — this is the only hard blocker.
Clean up the branch history with git rebase -i to collapse 15 commits to 3 meaningful ones.
Open a follow-up ticket for remaining WAI-ARIA tabs attributes (aria-controls, aria-labelledby, keyboard navigation).
Consider adding a renderTabs helper in the test file to match the pattern used in neighboring component tests like ConfirmationModal.
reasoning: The ARIA implementation is correct, minimal, and well-tested — the two attribute additions are exactly right and the four tests validate real accessibility semantics. The sole blocking issue is the accidental deletion of the 2.41.0 release notes block from releaseNotes.json, introduced during repeated bad merge conflict resolutions. Merging as-is would remove 32 shipped issues from the user-visible release history.
